description: This file is a module defining manipulation functions for jQuery, including DOM element cloning, removal, content insertion, and event handling, with dependencies on core and manipulation-specific modules.

methods.name: manipulationTarget
methods.description: Determines the appropriate container element for inserting new rows, preferring tbody over table.

methods.name: disableScript
methods.description: Temporarily disables script tags by changing their type attribute for safe DOM manipulation.

methods.name: restoreScript
methods.description: Restores script tags to their original type or removes the type attribute.

methods.name: cloneCopyEvent
methods.description: Copies event handlers and private data from source element to destination element.

methods.name: fixInput
methods.description: Fixes issues with cloned input elements, preserving checked state and default values.

methods.name: domManip
methods.description: Performs DOM manipulation tasks such as appending, prepending, inserting, and executing scripts.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes elements from the DOM, optionally cleaning data.
